newsitem.title: CANADA: CWB details Prairie elevator space, railcar unload.
newsitem.headline: CWB details Prairie elevator space, railcar unload.

text.p: The Canadian Wheat Board on Monday detailed the amount of space available in Prairie primary elevators and the number of hopper rail car unloads at export position.

Primary elevator space decreased over the past week as harvest progressed. Alberta elevators showed the most space at 43 percent, followed by Saskatchewan at 30 percent and Manitoba at 21 percent. Prairie-wide the average was 32 percent.
Rail car unloads came close to target in the past week. West Coast unloads totalled 2,581 cars. The target was 2,800.
Thunder Bay unloads totalled 2,270 cars, versus a target of 1,990. Unloads at Churchill totalled 278 cars, against a target of 300.
